title: Uncovering Factor-Level Preference to Improve Human-Model Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Using the PROFILE framework to calculate factor scores via Kendall's tau correlation, measuring the disproportionate influence of output length on LLM preference and generation compared to human baseline preferences.

Decomposing model outputs into fine-grained structural and stylistic factors (e.g., number of facts, novel word ratio, formality, and coherence) and quantifying how these algorithmic preferences diverge from human judgments during text generation versus discrimination.
